change_detection.method: Visual overlay of official 2017 outlines on official 9-inch 2023 imagery using shared EPSG:2230 service coordinates.

results.finding: No obvious plan-view change is visible between the 2017 outline and Spring 2023 roof/visible structure evidence at 9-inch resolution.

bounded_extract.scope: target parcel and immediate context only

imagery.orthorectification_note: The 2023 service identifies Nearmap imagery and a resampled regional dataset; the linked PDF is a 2020 order summary and does not establish parcel-specific 2023 rectification or shot time.
imagery.public_access: The 9-inch imagery is public domain under the SanGIS/Nearmap licensing agreement; 3-inch and oblique products are limited to project participants.
imagery.service: Imagery/SD2023_9inch with official Hosted/SD2023 export endpoint
imagery.suitability: Adequate to detect obvious plan-view roof/visible-outline change at approximately 9-inch ground sampling; not survey, mensuration, building-frame, or compliance geometry.

legal_lot_registration.control_used: Exact-APN SanGIS parcel geometry in EPSG:2230, used only as broad diagnostic control.
legal_lot_registration.finding: The sealed recorded map establishes legal identity and dimensions but has no surveyed coordinate registration to the 2023 image. Parcel V2/SanGIS geometry was not silently promoted to the legal boundary.

lot_coverage_suitability.reason: SDMC section 113.0240 uses the structure footprint measured from exterior wall or support surfaces and contains inclusions/exclusions not resolved by a roofline. The appropriate legal-lot denominator and survey registration also remain unresolved for measurement.

permit_search.absence_doctrine: Absence of a permit is not proof of absence of physical change.

records.relevance: Post-imagery address-matched record retained for completeness; stated scope does not establish or change structure footprint geometry.
records.scope: As built installation of approximately 105 lineal feet of new iron gas pipe; gas system leak repair and two gas system/meters.
records.system: City of San Diego Accela Citizen Access

opendsd_exact_address.coverage: indexed DSD approvals 2003-current subject to OpenDSD exclusions

product_wording: Official 2017 building outlines exist. Spring 2023 regional imagery shows no obvious plan-view change to the two directly linked outlines, but current compliance-grade structure geometry has not been established.

semantics.assessor_living_area: Parcel-level assessed living-area fact; not footprint, gross floor area, or structure geometry.
semantics.building_footprint: Context-dependent plan-view footprint; must state whether it follows walls, supports, roof, or another convention.
semantics.outer_edge_of_building_frame: Code reference edge for new-development setback measurement under SDMC section 113.0252(c).
semantics.permitted_structure_envelope: Approved design geometry; not evidence that the approved work was built exactly as drawn.
semantics.roof_outline: Visible roof edge in orthogonal imagery, affected by overhang, shadow, occlusion, and perspective/resampling.
semantics.visible_structure_outline: Observable plan-view edge without a guarantee that it is wall, frame, or support geometry.

setback_suitability.reason: The observed image edge is not the Code-defined outer edge of the building frame, and PM 17383 is not survey-registered to the image. Current-through-2026 geometry is also unresolved.

structure_count_reconciliation.conclusion: Structure count is not dwelling-unit count. Living area is not footprint, and the imagery does not establish legal units or complete current structure inventory.
structure_count_reconciliation.observed_2023: Two target-parcel roof/visible structure groupings remain visually consistent with the two directly linked historical outlines; one northern outline remains a linkage ambiguity.
